name: Ōshika (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ōshika village emblem in white: a stylised letter e-shaped device with a broken ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ōshika, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ōshika village emblem — a stylised letter e-shaped device with a broken ring
